mentions.name: Custom Linux distribution for 386DX-40
mentions.description: A self-built Linux distribution created to run on a vintage 386DX-40 PC, born from an attempt to get Linux working on the newly acquired retro hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: A very misguided project that started with me trying to run Linux on a newly acquired 386DX-40 and has led to me building my own Linux distribution for said purpose
